caller_script.text: This is Traffic Police Central Control Room calling. There is an overdue high court non-bailable e-challan of ten thousand rupees registered against your vehicle registration.
If the fine is not cleared immediately today, our squad will seize and impound your vehicle within two hours.
To settle the court fine directly, pay through our instant clearance UPI: echallan dot traffic dot pay at the rate ok axis. echallan.traffic.pay@okaxis.
